profile.headline: Working on JAX/Flax @ Google DeepMind
profile.summary:
Cristian is a Machine earning engineer and developer with a background in math and physics. He has extensive experience creating machine learning applications in fields such as autonomous vehicles, video analytics, and manufacturing. His strong combination of theory, coding, and infrastructure knowledge enables him to create real machine learning-based products. Contributor to various open source projects including Elegy (author), Pypeln (author) and Tensorflow Addons. He is a community leader and active speaker at conferences world-wide, founder of the Machine Learning Meetup Medellin, and cofounder of Machine Learning Colombia. Cristian is member of Toptal: top 3% of the developer talent in the world.

Skills: Python, Rust, Tensorflow, Pytorch, Jax, Docker, Kubleflow, Numpy, Pandas, ScikitLearn, AWS, GCP.

https://github.com/cgarciae/resume
cgarcia.e88@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer (Deep Learning, JAX)
positions.locationName: Greater London, England, United Kingdom · On-site

positions.title: Software Developer (Machine Learning)
positions.description: Working on the Flax open source project with the Google Brain team.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: We developed an Anomaly Detection system for the computing infrastructure of a large car manufacturing company using Unsupervised Learning techniques and tools like Scikit Learn, PySpark, Hive, and HDFS.

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: Developed Machine Learning applications to automate tasks throughout the company such as client sales prediction, demand forecast, photo aesthetics prediction, image clustering, models using GIS data, and more using both Machine Learning and Deep Learning.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: Developed Automatic Visual Inspection solutions using Deep Learning techniques for clients in the automotive industry. Developed an internal tool to that enabled training deep learning models with small datasets. Worked on a generative model for images using GANs.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: Toptal connects the top 3 % of freelance talent all over the world. Here I've worked with clients to develop computer vision and NLP applications.

positions.title: Lead Engineer in Computer Vision
positions.description: We developed various Deep Learning models for video classification, frame segmentation, and for and face recognition for a video analytics platform leveraging technologies such as Distributed Tensorflow, TPUs, and Dataflow.

positions.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description: We developed various technologies to improve the autonomy of the Kiwibots (delivery robots) using Deep Learning techniques for autonomous control. Leveraged various technologies such as TensorFlow, Apache BEAM, ML Engine, ROS, Jupyter, Flask.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Cofounder and lead developer of an Augmented Reality platform to automate the delivery of AR experiences. We developed a mobile client and backend using
tecnologies such as Unity3D, Elixir, Docker, Nginx, and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description: Designed the curriculum of various Data Science/ML courses. We created various PoCs using technologies such a TensorFlow and OpenCV to run ML algorithms in IoT devices.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Developed Linux and Windows python application for HR software to measure employee productivity. Cleaned and analyzed large datasets using Spark and Zeppelin. Created services in Python for Entity extracting using NLTK and ML prediction
service using Scikit Learning and Flask.

projects.title: Phi
projects.description: Phi library for functional programming in Python that intends to remove as much of the pain as possible from your functional programming experience in Python.

projects.title: TensorBuilder
projects.description: TensorBuilder is a TensorFlow-based library that enables you to easily create complex neural networks using functional programming.
